scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed && npm install --prefix ../frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
